Name: GiorgioFarmani
Author: berg64
Description:
Are you a farmer, or a phoenix rising from the ashes of atrocious Joja Corporate blandware? Are you jealous of those Animal Crossing fashionista wannabes and their in-game clothing designer? 

[i]Neanche per sogno![/i]

Make your farm beautiful. Unleash your own Giorgio Farmani line. Let the people of Stardew Valley be captivated by your flawless fashion. Sophisticated design and high quality materials for an always flawless look.

Don't let your dream of bringing high fashion to the bland people of Stardew be only a dream. Get yourself a sewing machine and CREATE! Click the Giorgio Farmani button to open up your DREAM WORKSPACE for making custom shirts right in-game.

Manifest.Name: GiorgioFarmani
Manifest.Description: Design custom pixel art shirts in-game using a built-in editor, accessible from the sewing machine.
Manifest.Author: berg64
